_source: Copied verbatim from jolt-relay spec/vectors/server-id.json (commit fb9c1b7) apart from this key. The relay repository is the source of truth: update the copy from there, never edit it here.
description: serverId = 'srv_' + lowercase RFC 4648 base32 (no padding) of the first 16 bytes of SHA-256(raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key).
